facts.fact: Rogue 强制 Kayla 休夜班，她却仍去 The Pit 喝酒
facts.anchor: It’s rare I get a night off, but Rogue forced me into it

facts.fact: 上周便利店碰见的男子重现酒吧，Kayla 认出他，稍后双方交换姓名：Vero 与 Kayla
facts.anchor: I turn to see the guy I met last week at the convenience store, and he beams a huge smile at me.

facts.fact: Vero 邀 Kayla 去另一家酒吧，她觉得他新鲜有趣，虽知跟陌生人离开有危险仍答应
facts.anchor: “Vero. Wanna go to a different bar?

facts.fact: Vero 说自己高中辍学、打零工，后来在地下格斗场认识 Brawley
facts.anchor: “I dropped out of high school and took on odd jobs for a while until one day I went to an underground fight, where I met Brawley.

facts.fact: Vero 向 Kayla 交代 Brawley 既是好友也是伴侣，两人也与女性交往，他承认自己刚才忘了说明重要信息
facts.anchor: He is my best friend, but he is also mine.

facts.fact: Vero 带 Kayla 穿过灯光路径到 Ares's Bar，里面的人们在他们入场时安静下来
facts.anchor: He pushes open a door that says “Ares’s Bar” and waits for me to step inside.

facts.fact: Ares 制止 Vero 急于介绍，先让 Kayla 喘口气与点饮品，三人相识
facts.anchor: “Let her breathe, Vero,” Ares says, not unkindly, but almost reminding Vero how to act.

facts.fact: Vero 坦白想追逐 Kayla，也说若她不愿意就退回朋友关系；Kayla 要求更清楚地解释
facts.anchor: If it’s too much, tell me to back off and we will be friends—that part is non-negotiable because I like you.

facts.fact: Ares 在 Vero 说出夜场秘密之前让 Kayla 读并签保密协议，随后提出三人一起参观；Kayla 发现自己比预想更醉
facts.anchor: “It’s an NDA. Whatever he tells you tonight stays private.”
